name: Limited Liability Company Alis

attribution.legal_posture: OFAC designated the Vladivostok-based company as subordinate to Chinyong; Treasury reported more than $2.5 million in payments to its parent company during 2021-2022. This is an administrative sanctions designation; criminal charge and conviction status remain absent.

caveats: Administrative sanctions are an administrative finding; the record carries no criminal charge or conviction.
SDN.CSV and ADD.CSV are component tables of one current OFAC dataset; together they form one corroboration source.
Tax, registration, street-address, and unrelated sanctions fields are excluded.
